en.headline: 6 own commits plus 12 automated in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu
en.summary: **6 own commits** were made in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 12 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own work updated `.gitignore` rules for `.history` and `.history/scripts/daily`, added comments to an error-handling function in `generate-activity.mjs`, and refactored `diagnose` probing so deduplication keys include headers with a `catch` fallback. It also optimized concurrent probing to reduce duplicate requests and improve performance. In `openchamber/openchamber`, the user opened issue #5584, “[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied with a `fix-ready` note stating the cause had been traced and that the fix mainly involves wiring `loadHistoryUntilMessage` into the timeline control. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 有 6 次本人提交，另有 12 次自动提交
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 完成 **6 次本人提交**，另有 12 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。本人提交更新了 `.gitignore` 中针对 `.history` 与 `.history/scripts/daily` 的忽略规则，为 `generate-activity.mjs` 中的错误处理函数补充注释，并重构 `diagnose` 探测逻辑，使去重键包含 headers，同时为 probe 增加 `catch` 兜底。还优化了并发探测逻辑，以减少重复请求并提升性能。在 `openchamber/openchamber`，用户新开了 issue #5584 “[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复称已定位原因并标记 `fix-ready`，指出修复主要是将 `loadHistoryUntilMessage` 接入 timeline control。当天没有 pull request、review、发布或讨论活动。
